sets.title: Law and method changes
sets.what: Changes since 2016 that break year-to-year comparisons.
rows: SB 747 (S.L. 2023-140): mail ballots must be RECEIVED by 7:30 p.m. Election Day; the 3-day postmark grace period ended.
2016-2022 counted mail arriving up to 3 days late (postmarked); 2024 and 2026 do not. Small reduction of late mail.
SB 747: same-day registrants at one-stop vote a retrievable ballot that is removed if address verification mail is returned undeliverable.
SDR counts 2024-2026 include ballots later removed ('SDR-FAILED VERIFICATION' 1,055 in 2024 per NCSBE file).
Photo ID required in person and a copy with mail ballots (Holmes v. Moore, NC Supreme Court 2023; first general with ID 2024).
2016-2022 had no photo ID (2016 blocked by court).

One-stop (early voting) was recodified as G.S. 163-166.35 by S.L. 2023-140: starts the third Thursday before ED, ends 3 p.m. the last Saturday. 2026: Oct 15 - Oct 31 (17 days); 2024: Oct 17 - Nov 2; 2022: Oct 20 - Nov 5; 2018: Oct 17 - Nov 3.

One-stop opens on the third Thursday before ED (ED-19) in every comparison year since 2018, so 11 days out = day 9 of one-stop in 2018, 2022, 2024 and 2026 alike; the 2016 window differed (opened Oct 20, ED-19, but with county-varied hours). Like-for-like by days-before-ED holds.
County boards count absentee ballots at absentee meetings before ED; one-stop and mail results are reported first after 7:30 p.m. (ET). County canvass at 11 a.m. on the tenth day after the election.
Early/mail vote (D-leaning by registration) reports first; Election Day vote later.
Mid-decade congressional redraw for 2026 (2025 act, NC-01 made more Republican per registry relay). 2026 CD numbers do not match 2024 territory.
BREAK fixed here: prior-year same-day ballots are re-fit to 2026 CDs by joining each voter to the 2026 voter file (cd_ev.csv rows 're-fit to 2026 lines').
County boards canvass at 11:00 a.m. on the tenth day after the election (Fri Nov 13, 2026); State Board canvass later in November.
late-arriving mail counted (or not): final mail counts and post-ED count timing differ
